newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish slightly higher.

text.p: U.S. debt futures ended up slightly, cheered by the perception the Fed is in no hurry to raise interest rates, but held back by profit-taking.
Action was choppy at times, and debt futures cut their gains several times amid profit-taking and auction jitters, but traders said a buy-the-dips mentality persisted overall.

Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony today to a Senate banking panel was the same as he gave to a House panel on Tuesday. Greenspan told Congress that growth had moderated and suggested any rise in interest rates to head off inflation would not be needed in the near future.
"The technicals are still positive, the order flow is still of a bullish nature and the Fed appears to be on hold," said John Nyhoff, chief economist for Mitusbishi Financial Futures.
September T-bonds rallied to a new high for the year at 115-23/32 early in moderate trade. Resistance at 115-24/32 and 25/32 capped the market, as did minor profit-taking.
September closed up 4/32 at 115-12/32, in a range from 115-7/32 to 115-23/32.
While settling off their daily peak, "the held a firm tone into the close," a T-bond futures trader said.
John Kadich, floor analyst with Dean Witter, said September may be on track to test support at 115-2/32, but said the dip would find buyers.
He said September bounced well off of 115-7/32 support and said 114-29/32 to 115-02/32 should hold any further losses.
"It was an orderly downmove and we never really hit stops," Kadich said of the retreat from multi-month peaks.
"We still could get down to these support levels but it'll be met by new buying." he said. "If we do get to 114-23/32 it'll be a deeper correction, but more of a back and fill move," Kadich said.
"We're overbought but they don't care," a Eurodollar broker said.
Treasury acutioned $11.5 billion in five year notes, in what traders called a positive auction.
At the close, September T-bonds were up 4/32 at 115-12/32, 10-year notes were up 2/32 at 110-05/32, and December Eurodollars were up 0.020 basis points at 94.135.
